IMPORTANT: Write your output to the file: C:\Users\mallo\Deterministic_Concept_scoring\fusion-tea\exploration\concept_analysis\analyses\20b-renaissance-stellarator\iter-1\model_setup.py

`spec['p_input'] = 0.0` gives p_input/P_native = 0.000, outside the physically reasonable band [0.005, 0.5]. p_input/P_native must lie in [0.5%, 50%]. p_input is the AUXILIARY heating wallplug (NBI/ICRH/ECRH/LHCD), NOT fusion power. Steady-state MFE recirculates ~5-15% of net electric; pulsed concepts can run lower. A value above this band almost certainly means fusion power was transcribed into p_input by mistake (the concept 05/09 failure mode). Find the SEPARATE heating-power figure in your source paper (often labelled 'auxiliary heating', 'NBI', 'p_aux') and use THAT.
